scripts.drivercom-fetch: cd src-tauri/binaries && gh release download -R pmotionf/drivercom-cli -p '*-drivercom-cli-*.zip' --clobber
scripts.drivercom: bun run drivercom-prepare && bun run drivercom-fetch && bun run drivercom-unpack
scripts.fetch-mmc-cli: cd src-tauri/resources && gh release download -R pmotionf/mmc-cli -p '*-mmc-cli-*.zip' --clobber
scripts.mmc-cli: bun run mmc-cli-prepare &&  bun run fetch-mmc-cli && bun run unpack-mmc-cli
scripts.fetch-mmc-api: mkdir -p src/components/proto && cd src/components/proto && gh release download -R pmotionf/mmc-api -A 'zip' --clobber
scripts.mmc-api: bun run fetch-mmc-api && bun run unpack-mmc-api && bun run buf generate
scripts.mmc-api-version: mkdir -p src-tauri/generated && cd src-tauri/generated  && gh release -R pmotionf/mmc-api list --json name,tagName,publishedAt,isLatest > api.json
scripts.pretauri: bun run drivercom && bun run prep && bun run mmc-api && bun run mmc-api-version
bun run drivercom && bun run mmc-cli && bun run prep && bun run mmc-api
